# hpe_morpheus_virtual_switches (Data Source)



Lists the virtual switches defined on a cluster. Each entry is a summary row; use
`hpe_morpheus_virtual_switch` to read the full segment and uplink detail for a single
switch. Requires Morpheus 9.1.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_virtual_switches" "example" {
  cluster_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster (server group) whose virtual switches are returned.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_switches` (Attributes List) The list of virtual switches in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_switches))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_switches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_switches`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the switch is active.
- `base_type` (String) The switch base type.
- `bond_mode` (String) NIC bonding mode. Null indicates single-NIC (no bond) mode.
- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster that owns this switch.
- `code` (String) The code identifier for the switch.
- `description` (String) The description of the switch.
- `id` (Number) The Morpheus ID of the virtual switch.
- `mtu` (Number) Switch MTU.
- `name` (String) Switch name.
- `network_count` (Number) Number of traffic segments defined on the switch.
- `nic_count` (Number) Number of distinct physical NICs consumed across all host uplinks.
- `segments` (Attributes List) Traffic-type summary of the segments defined on the switch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_switches--segments))
- `status` (String) Sync status of the switch.
- `status_message` (String) Additional detail about the current status, when present.

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_switches--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_switches.segments`

Read-Only:

- `traffic_type` (String) The traffic type carried by this segment.
